question: Which aircraft are not serviceable, and what stops each one?
answer: Aircraft SYN-04 is not serviceable because its battery pack BAT-04A is 6 cycles past its 300-cycle life limit, and battery pack BAT-04B passed its 24-calendar-month life limit on 2026-03-31. Aircraft SYN-03 is serviceable with deferred defects because its 100-hour inspection is 3.6 h overdue, within the 10 h tolerance that allows flight only to reach a place where the inspection can be done. Aircraft SYN-05 is in maintenance since 2026-08-07 due to a synthetic low-battery message in flight 2, requiring inspection of the battery connector and pack before the next flight. Aircraft SYN-07 is on the ground awaiting parts since 2026-08-14 due to a synthetic replacement propeller set on order after a ground strike. No other aircraft are not serviceable. Hours and cycles items cannot be predicted because they advance only with flight; only calendar limits have a date.
